s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive lower urinary tract symptoms with hematuria and urethral mass
salient_findings: Nocturia two to three times per night
key_facts: 53-year-old man
3-year history of lower urinary tract symptoms
Nocturia two to three times per night
Slow urinary stream
Microscopic hematuria
Urinalysis showed 3-5 red cells per high-power field
No history of lichen sclerosis, sexually transmitted infection, pelvic radiation, genitourinary trauma, or family history of genitourinary malignancy
Renal ultrasonography findings were normal
Flexible cystourethroscopy revealed a circumferential urethral mass
Biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma
Biopsy specimens demonstrated amyloid protein deposition
Retrograde urethrography showed an approximately 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra

differentials: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Urethra
per_call: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Urethra

shortlist.label: Localized Urethral Amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy specimens demonstrated amyloid protein deposition and urethral mass

shortlist.label: Urethral Stricture
shortlist.why_kept: Retrograde urethrography showed a 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra

shortlist.label: Urothelial Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Flexible cystourethroscopy revealed a circumferential urethral mass, although biopsy was negative

shortlist.label: Primary Amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Amyloid protein deposition, but no other organ involvement

shortlist.label: Secondary Amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Association with chronic inflammatory diseases, but patient lacks a clear history

raw.rationale: The presence of a circumferential urethral mass with biopsy specimens demonstrating amyloid protein deposition and the absence of systemic amyloidosis manifestations support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Urethral Stricture
rejected.why: While retrograde urethrography showed a segment of stenosis, the primary finding of amyloid protein deposition points towards a different underlying cause.

rejected.label: Urothelial Carcinoma
rejected.why: Biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma, ruling out this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Primary Amyloidosis
rejected.why: The lack of systemic involvement and the localized nature of the amyloid deposition in the urethra do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Secondary Amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is no mention of chronic inflammatory diseases or other conditions that would lead to secondary amyloidosis, and the amyloidosis is localized to the urethra.
